verdicts.criticalReason: Direct contradiction of Acceptance Criteria: AC requires 'When tested end-to-end Then boundaries must remain isolated' but the provided test testBoundedContextIsolation is a repository-level integration test using @SpringBootTest and @Transactional directly calling repository interfaces like organizationRepository.save, not an end-to-end test.

concerns.text: The test testBoundedContextIsolation uses non-deterministic sources OffsetDateTime.now() and UUID.randomUUID() without injection/seeding, which violates the reproducible tests rule.
